entries.message: Quick Windows on Mac now have Back and Forward, Site Controls and the Space's pinned extensions, with the extensions that don't fit behind one button.
Command-L now selects a Quick Window's address field on Mac.
On Mac, New Quick Window works while a Quick Window is in front, and a link's menu in a Quick Window or Peek offers Open Link in New Quick Window.
A site's permission request on Mac stays open when its page moves from a Quick Window into a browser window, and when the site asks before a Quick Window has finished opening.
Site Controls and permission requests now stay readable over any page, Space color or surface material.
On Mac, the page behind Peek fades darker as Peek opens while the sidebar keeps its brightness. Settings > Links > Dim the page behind Peek turns it off.
A Quick Window opened beside Split View on Mac no longer opens narrower than its smallest size.

On Mac, clicking a Quick Window's address or pressing Command-L opens the command palette right there, starting at the address, with results from the Quick Window's Space. A blank Quick Window opens with it.
On iPhone, tapping the address bar opens the command palette from the bar, with its results rising above it and the best match nearest the bar.
A Quick Window on Mac no longer resizes narrower than its toolbar fits, which cut off Open In and slid Back and Forward under the window's buttons.
The command palette's results now take exactly the height of their rows, so a short list on iPhone no longer cuts off its first result or shows a scroll bar.
On Mac, Peek uses more of the page while still floating above it, with a round Close button and pill-shaped Open In, and its controls move with the card as it opens.
Shift-click can now open links in Peek. Choose it in Settings > Links > Open Peek with.
Pinned extensions behind » in a Quick Window on Mac keep their right-click menu, and Command-L opens the palette in a blank Quick Window.
On iPhone, the address bar's palette stays below the top of the screen at the largest text sizes.
